findings.title: Replay evidence is not bound to the record, provider or knowledge cutoff under evaluation

minimal_counterexample.observed: replay_status=ELIGIBLE; with a non-empty reviewed root decision=ACCEPT_FIELD_BINDING

findings.expected: replay admissibility is a claim about THIS record at THIS cutoff; foreign or post-cutoff evidence must be refused
findings.cause: _adjudicate_replay(request.replay_evidence) receives only the evidence. ReplayEvidence (I05 TimeEvidenceBase) carries no record id, provider or cutoff, and assess_replay_eligibility(evidence) takes no cutoff, so the policy owns adjudication but not evidence provenance.
downstream_controls: ACCEPT_FIELD_BINDING once an operator supplies a non-empty manifest
A15 (forged evaluation) does not cover it
findings.production_reachability: the false replay_status claim is visible today; acceptance is unreachable only because the shipped root approves no artifact
findings.required_repair: bound the evidence in the policy from existing fields: require every revision.selected[*].source_revision_id == request.record.source_revision_id and market_available_at <= knowledge_cutoff, else REFUSE/REPLAY_BLOCKED. No I05 amendment is required for this bounded repair; an I05-wide binding is the alternative if the operator prefers it.

findings.title: The verifier-crash verdict relays a trusted dependency's exception message verbatim
findings.positive_control: a custody failure on the post-verification re-read is reported with a fixed message and leaks nothing
findings.expected: module docstring claims no detail carries payload; the crash path carries whatever the dependency said
findings.cause: the generic handler in evaluate() builds its detail from type(exc).__name__ and str(exc)
findings.production_reachability: requires a wired trusted dependency to raise; not caller-selectable. No artifact or evidence bytes are echoed (verified).
findings.required_repair: relay only the exception class, as the authority handler already does, or hash/redact the message.

findings.title: An unexpected failure in the evidence-rebinding loader escapes evaluate()

minimal_counterexample.observed: KeyError escapes TrustConsumerPolicy.evaluate; no verdict is returned

findings.positive_control: all nine request-level bypasses in the P04a matrix returned a verdict (0 unexpected exceptions)
findings.expected: every stage outside the verifier handler should still produce a fail-closed verdict
findings.production_reachability: COMPOSITION (X02/X03): the loader is trusted code; no hostile request was found that reaches it with an unexpected exception type
findings.required_repair: wrap the rebinding stage in the same bounded exception handler as _derive, mapping to VERIFIER_CRASH and letting BaseException propagate.

environment_limitations: The I08/I09 evidence producers spawn a numpy/OpenBLAS process that aborted with 'Memory allocation still failed after 10 retries' on this host during compound runs. Two governance cases (m18/m20) are environment-sensitive; the direct six-audit run passed 180/180 and the clean governance run passed 27/27 before the host became unstable.
The full canonical ~5,000-node collection was not run by this auditor (Agent 1 owns it).
The accept path requires a wiring-double root (X01/X03) because the shipped manifest approves nothing; findings that need it are labelled COMPOSITION.
disposition_basis: F1 (MEDIUM) makes the verdict claim replay admissibility it did not establish and would grant acceptance on foreign evidence as soon as an operator supplies a non-empty root. F2/F3 are bounded hardening items. Rungs 1-5 are otherwise accepted, with canonical acceptance pending.
